## What's new

- 🌙 **Overnight rules**: a slot whose end time is earlier than its start (e.g. Monday 22:00 → 06:00) now ends the next day without any extra setting. An explicit end day still always wins. Scheduler, calendar and weekly card all follow the same rule.
- 📅 **Multi-day slots are fully drawn** in the weekly card: start day to the bottom of the grid, intermediate days at full height, end day from the top to the end time. Clicking any piece opens the rule.
- 🔎 **New entity picker** in the rule dialog: search by name or entity id, dropdown with icon, friendly name and id, keyboard and mouse support, respects the card's include/exclude domains. It no longer depends on Home Assistant's internal picker component.
- 📦 **Cards register themselves**: the integration loads the two cards automatically with the version in the URL, so an update can never be hidden by a browser or CDN cache (e.g. Cloudflare). **Manual Lovelace Resources are no longer needed** — if you added `/local/chronotask/…` in the past you can remove those two entries (leaving them is harmless). Works with storage and YAML dashboards.

Full changelog from the beta channel: v1.4.0-beta1 → v1.4.0-beta6.

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/andker87/Home-Assistant-ChronoTask/compare/v1.3.0...v1.4.0
